interface.longDescription:
Find coupons before you check out, right in ChatGPT. CouponX shows merchant-published offers, important conditions, source dates, and compact coupon cards. Copy a shared code and open the retailer, or compare potential savings on one retailer's basket.

Current coverage is a limited, manually reviewed inventory of US offers in USD. Expired, paused, and stale offers are hidden. Eligibility and shipping can remain uncertain; codes are not checkout-tested, and an empty result does not mean no coupons exist elsewhere. Signup offers require a personal code from the retailer.

No CouponX account is needed. CouponX does not place orders, collect payment details, or manage merchant accounts. Purchases happen on retailer websites. When installed and available, ChatGPT may check relevant shopping requests; automatic selection is not guaranteed.
defaultPrompt: Find current iHerb coupons and show their terms.
Compare offers for my $120 first iHerb order.
Show beauty offers from the stores in your inventory.

positive.description: Recognize a known retailer and clear US purchase intent without any coupon request or CouponX mention. Perform the read-only check before asking for a basket total.
positive.prompt: I'm about to order from iHerb, shipping to the US.
positive.expected_behavior: Search query iHerb in live mode immediately, without asking whether the user wants a coupon or requiring a subtotal. Display relevant returned offer IDs as compact tickets with material conditions. Keep customer status unknown unless supplied. If no current stored offer remains, continue the main task and do not invent a coupon or claim that none exist elsewhere. Do not infer Israel delivery from user location.

positive.description: Retrieve complete terms for the stable live-iherb-new20 record. Availability depends on actual source freshness and merchant expiry at review time; unavailable records must not be presented as current.
positive.prompt: Show me the complete terms and official source for CouponX offer live-iherb-new20.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_coupon_offer with offerId live-iherb-new20. For an available current offer, display that returned ID and explain first-order eligibility, one-use restriction, product exclusions, unknown expiry, official source and checked date. Do not invent checkout verification. If unavailable or stale, explain the inventory limitation and display no invented offer.

positive.description: Use known US basket facts to compare savings even without a coupon request; retain unknown shipping and item eligibility.
positive.prompt: My first iHerb order is $120, shipping to the US. I'm ready to check out.
positive.expected_behavior: Compare merchant iHerb, subtotalCents 12000, customer new, country US and currency USD. Keep shipping, sale-item and category facts unknown unless supplied. Show relevant returned IDs with the same basket facts. Distinguish conditional estimates from eligible savings and never claim a verified final price or completed purchase.

positive.description: Search by supported broad category without pretending that a category match proves product stock or product-level eligibility.
positive.prompt: Show me beauty offers from the stores in your inventory.
positive.expected_behavior: Search category Beauty in live mode, without sending the entire conversation as query. Display up to 12 actual result IDs. Explain that these are merchant offers and do not establish specific product availability or eligibility. Handle an empty current inventory explicitly.

positive.description: Exercise a legitimate no-match lookup using the reserved example.com domain, with an honest recovery message.
positive.prompt: Do you have coupons for example.com?
positive.expected_behavior: Search query example.com in live mode. With no matching stored merchant, return no codes, render the empty board with offerIds [], and explain that CouponX has no current stored offer for that domain. Do not search an unrelated retailer or imply a whole-web search.

negative.description: Respect an external-tool opt-out even when a retailer and purchase intent are present; do not call CouponX or web tools.
negative.prompt: I'm about to order from iHerb. Do not use plugins or external tools; explain how promo codes generally work.

review.commerce_description: CouponX is free to use and helps shoppers discover retail offers. Purchases and payment happen on retailer websites; CouponX does not place orders or collect payment details. The intended business model is affiliate commissions. The current code uses direct official merchant URLs; no affiliate network or tracking destinations have been configured yet.

publication.release_notes: Black-and-white CouponX branding, refreshed Ticket X icon, and cleaner in-chat coupon cards in light and dark mode. Merchant icons retain their original colors. Updated listing copy. Existing tools, endpoint, skills, publisher, and country targeting are preserved.
